Yellow sleeveless fitted hiking tank with a secure high neck, black short utility skirt over opaque shorts, light open white long vest, flat hiking sandals. Bare arms shoulders and legs, tiny red bead compass charm.

Fully lined golden yellow two-piece swimwear: secure wide-strap square-neck top with black edging and supportive opaque underband, high-waisted opaque full-coverage bottoms, white wrap sarong with side slit. Bare shoulders arms midriff legs, small red orb pendant.

In a sunlit coastal veranda craft nook at late morning, holding a small wooden wind-chime bar in both separated hands above a worktable while checking the translucent sea-glass pieces hanging from it; complete hands and glass pieces inside crop, sea breeze through linen curtains.

Opaque ivory linen V-neck strappy jumpsuit with yellow sash and secure fitted bodice, an open lightweight black mesh cardigan around elbows. Bare shoulders arms and side-waist cutouts, tiny red gemstone ear studs.
